summary: A light, quiet comparison demo on a #f4f4f4 page: two identical white cards stacked (top [48,48,1344,480], bottom [48,552,1344,480], ~40px corner radius). Each card has a handwritten-script title at top-left ("Delay on every hover" in magenta, "Delay once, then instant" in mint green), a grey "N.Ns waiting" counter at top-right, a centred floating white formatting toolbar (691x78, ~18px radius, soft drop shadow) holding Body▾ | B I U S | link code quote | a coloured dot (magenta on top, mint on bottom), and a full-width 10px grey timeline track near the card bottom. Only one card is active at a time; the other sits at ~30% opacity. 0–7.8s the top card runs: an arrow cursor enters, turns into a pointing hand, and hovers B, I, U, S, link, code, quote left to right (~0.9s per button). Each hover shows a light-grey hover square, a small blue spinner ring plus a light-blue pill counting down "500ms"→"0ms" beside the cursor, then a near-black tooltip ("Bold ⌘B", "Italic ⌘I", …) fades in above the button; the previous tooltip lingers grey as it fades out. The waiting counter climbs 0.5s per button to 3.5s and the timeline paints one ~83px blue segment per wait, leaving seven segments and a "6.9s" label that rides the timeline's end. At ~7.8s the top card dims and the bottom card wakes: the same sweep happens, but only the first hover (B) waits 500ms; every later tooltip appears instantly in solid black with "0ms". Its counter stops at 0.5s and its timeline holds one blue segment with the label ending at "3.7s". Around 13.4–14.2s the top card fades back to full, so the clip ends holding both cards side by side: 3.5s/6.9s vs 0.5s/3.7s.

criteria.check: The area around the cards is flat light grey (~#f4f4f4), slightly darker than the white cards
There are exactly two white cards stacked one above the other, each about 1344x480 px
The top card spans about x 48–1392, y 48–528, and the bottom card about y 552–1032, with a ~24px gap between them
The card corners are large and rounded, radius about 40px
The top card's title reads exactly 'Delay on every hover' in a handwritten script font
The top title is magenta/pink (~#d02f9e)
The bottom card's title reads exactly 'Delay once, then instant' in the same handwritten script
The bottom title is mint green (~#4fd6a6)
The top-right text reads '3.5s waiting', right-aligned to x≈1352, in mid grey regular sans ~22px
The bottom card's top-right text reads '0.5s waiting'
The toolbar is centred horizontally in the card at about x 374–1065, y 229–307 (bottom card's at y 733–811)
The toolbar is white with ~18px rounded corners and a soft, wide grey drop shadow below it (not a hard border)
Left to right the toolbar holds: 'Body' with a down chevron, B, I, U, S, a chain link, '< >', a quote/list icon, and a filled colour dot
Three thin light-grey vertical dividers split the toolbar: after Body, after S, and before the colour dot
The top toolbar's dot is solid magenta and the bottom toolbar's dot is solid mint green, each ~24px
A thin (~10px) rounded light-grey track runs across the card at y≈483, from x 88 to 1352
The top timeline shows exactly 7 separate sky-blue segments, each ~83px long, with grey gaps between
The top timeline ends with the black label '6.9s' near x 1255–1292
The bottom timeline shows exactly 1 sky-blue segment at its left end (x≈88–171)
The bottom timeline's label reads '3.7s' at about x 725–765
While the top card runs, the bottom card's title, counter, toolbar icons and dot are faded to about 30% (pale mint title, light grey icons)
A settled tooltip is a near-black (~#151515) rounded rectangle (~10px radius, ~44px tall) with white text
The tooltip over B reads 'Bold ⌘B'
The tooltip is horizontally centred over the hovered button with its bottom ~12px above the toolbar's top edge
The hovered button sits on a light-grey rounded square (~64x62, ~12px radius)
Over a button the cursor is a white pointing-hand with black outline; while travelling it is a black arrow
Below-right of the cursor sits a thin sky-blue spinner ring followed by a light-blue rounded pill with teal-blue text
The pill reads '458ms' and the ring shows a partial arc (counting down)
Once the delay is over the pill reads '0ms' next to a solid sky-blue ring
After the cursor moves from B to I, the old 'Bold ⌘B' tooltip stays visible in grey (fading) and is replaced by a grey, fading-in 'Italic ⌘I' tooltip above I
The strikethrough tooltip reads 'Strikethrough ⌘⇧X'
The quote tooltip reads 'Quote ⌘⇧9' and is solid black
The hand cursor steps left to right across the buttons one per ~0.9s: on I at 2.4s, on the link at 4.8s, on the quote icon at 6.8s
The top counter climbs in 0.5s steps as each delay completes: '0.5s waiting' at 1.9s, '1.0s' at 2.4s, '2.1s' at 4.8s, '3.2s' at 6.8s
The top timeline grows from 2 blue blocks plus a label '1.6s' to 4 full blocks plus a stub and label '4.0s' as the sweep proceeds
The black time label rides just after the painted end of the timeline, moving right as time passes (e.g. ~x 285 at 1.9s, ~x 1100 at 6.8s)
Around 7.8s the active panel switches: the top card fades to ~30% and the bottom card's title, counter, toolbar and dot turn full strength
In the bottom card the first hover (B) shows a counting spinner '194ms' and the counter rises to '0.3s waiting' with a short blue timeline stub '0.3s'
In the bottom card, later hovers (U onwards) show a solid black tooltip immediately with the pill at '0ms', with no counting delay and no grey fade-in
The bottom counter stays at '0.5s waiting' from the second hover to the end while its timeline adds no new blue segments
Between ~13.4s and ~14.2s the dimmed top card fades back to full strength, so at the end both cards show at full colour
The final state (both cards, no cursor, no tooltip) holds still from ~14.2s to the end
At the start an arrow cursor rests in empty space at ~(903,380) with a pale '500ms' pill below it, before moving onto B
B is bold, I is a slanted bar, U is underlined, S has a strike line, all dark ~#1a1a1a at ~22px in the active toolbar
The link, code and quote icons are thin-stroke line icons with the same silhouettes (chain loops, '< >', staggered lines)
